title: EvaluationManifest
description: The independent source of truth for one task. Supplied SEPARATELY from harness evidence, by whoever owns the task rather than by the agent being graded. Without a manifest a decision cannot receive a math grade, no matter what the harness claims about itself. The evaluator set is deliberately small: this is a grading protocol, not a workflow engine.

authority.description: Which Gradebook grade source a passing evaluation confers. A manifest CANNOT confer math authority with an evaluator that is not deterministic, which is enforced by the constraint below rather than by convention.

ext.description: Reserved forward-compatibility namespace, the only place unknown fields are permitted.

allOf.description: Structural enforcement of the protocol's most important rule. An ai_judge evaluator can never carry math authority, so a model's opinion cannot be laundered into the headline metric by editing one field of a manifest.
Reality authority is conferred by an outcome that arrives later, not by running a checker at decision time.

oneOf.title: exact_equality
oneOf.description: The chosen value equals the expected value after normalization.

oneOf.title: json_equality
oneOf.description: Structural JSON equality, order-insensitive for object keys and order-sensitive for arrays.

oneOf.title: command_exit_code
oneOf.description: A command's exit status is the verdict. The command is declared here, in the manifest, and NOT taken from harness evidence, so the process being graded cannot choose the test that grades it.

command.description: argv form, never a shell string, so there is no shell to inject into.

oneOf.title: file_digest
oneOf.description: A file's content hash equals an expected hash.

oneOf.title: json_schema
oneOf.description: The chosen value validates against a schema. Proves shape, not truth, which is why it is a weaker but still deterministic authority.

oneOf.title: callback
oneOf.description: An application-provided checker resolved by name from a registry the application controls. The name is a lookup key, never an import path or callable, so a manifest cannot cause arbitrary code to load.

oneOf.title: outcome
oneOf.description: No checker runs. The verdict arrives later as an OutcomeRecord and is graded with reality authority.
